test-crypto-no-algorithm.js: Expects the process to abort when --openssl-config enables only OpenSSL's base provider; the browser runtime has no OpenSSL and no OpenSSL configuration to load.
test-crypto-subtle-cross-realm.js: Needs an ArrayBuffer made in a vm context to have that context's own ArrayBuffer.prototype; a browser worker can't create another V8 realm.
test-crypto-provider-cache-snapshot.js: Builds a V8 startup snapshot (--build-snapshot) under an OpenSSL config that loads the legacy provider; a browser can neither build V8 snapshots nor load OpenSSL providers.
test-crypto-pqc-keygen-slh-dsa.js: Generates 96 SLH-DSA key pairs; the JavaScript implementation (@noble/post-quantum) takes about a second per SHAKE "s" key pair, over the 30 s budget. SLH-DSA itself works (the other SLH-DSA tests pass).
